content.text: Digital creators in regions where platforms like Stripe or PayPal are unavailable face a significant hurdle: monetizing their work. With conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-my-unfiltered-take|payment]] gateways locking them out, many turn to suboptimal solutions that eat into their profits. This post details how to utilize GitHub Pages as a free hosting solution for a digital product store, allowing creators to keep more of their earnings while operating outside the bounds of restrictive platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-7. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

Using GitHub Pages to host a digital product store provides a sovereign infrastructure solution for creators unable to use mainstream payment systems. This approach eliminates the high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale. Instead, you can leverage NOWPayments, which only charges 0.5%. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-selling-ebooks-without-paypal-6|COREMERCH guide to difference]] results in significant savings; for example, on 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain an additional $921. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-github-pages-free-digital-product-8|The Real]] is about empowerment and ownership, providing a way to build a robust online business without being constrained by traditional payment processing.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture utilizes GitHub Pages for free web hosting, which allows you to publish your digital products effortlessly. When a customer makes a purchase, the backend logic is managed through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which handle payment processing and order fulfillment. NOWPayments acts as the gateway for cryptocurrency transactions, converting prices in real-time and ensuring that payments are verified on-chain. This setup not only streamlines the buying experience but also ensures that you maintain full ownership of your data and product delivery processes.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or overly restrictive. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, this system gives you the tools to monetize your skills without surrendering a large percentage of your earnings to third-party services. The architecture is built for those who value independence and want to take full control of their online sales without compromising on efficiency.
Switch to a sovereign architecture to retain more of your profits.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The system consists of several key components: GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, NOWPayments for payment processing, and a storage solution like Google Drive for file delivery. By integrating these elements, you create a seamless experience for customers, from browsing products to instant delivery upon payment confirmation. This combination ensures that you can run your digital store efficiently and effectively, while maintaining full sovereignty over your commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, follow these steps: First, set up your GitHub Pages account and create a repository for your store. Next, configure Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage your backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments to handle transactions and ensure your product files are stored on Google Drive or a similar platform for easy delivery. Finally, test your system thoroughly to ensure that everything operates smoothly before launching. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
GitHub Pages provides a robust hosting solution at no cost.

If you're looking to expand your digital product offerings, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to take full control of your online sales.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?
You can sell an ebook online by using GitHub Pages to host it and integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This allows you to bypass traditional payment gateways.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Utilizing GitHub Pages alongside NOWPayments allows you to sell digital downloads while minimizing fees. This setup can dramatically increase your profit margins.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by leveraging GitHub Pages for hosting and using NOWPayments for payment processing, you can effectively sell templates and fonts without relying on platforms like Gumroad.
What are the costs associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee per transaction, significantly lower than many other platforms. This makes it a cost-effective choice for digital creators.
How do I ensure my products are delivered automatically?
You can automate product delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing and file delivery after payment confirmation.
NOWPayments offers the lowest transaction fees in the market.
